Emily (CS): Heads up — tomorrow 09:00 PST enablement office hours is double-booked with NovusBio migration. Can someone cover or move? :wave:
Jordan: I can split and take 09:00–09:30, but need clarity on customer priority. Who's the must-have?
Samir: NovusBio migration window is immovable, priority HIGH. If possible move the general drop-in to 11:00 local.
Lee (Enablement): 11:00 should be fine from content side, but Karen has a 11:00 prep block. @Katie Ops can you check facilitator roster?
Katie Ops: I can swap Karen to 09:30–10:30 and cover 11:00–12:00. Will update calendar and resend invites.
Emily (CS): Amazing — thank you! After swap please add a quick note in the event: "NovusBio priority migration — limited seats" so folks don't RSVP incorrectly.
RemyBot: Calendar update successful — event 491827 moved to 11:00; invites resent to attendee list; room: Enablement Main.
Jordan: Small operational ask — can we add a 15m post-session feedback poll? Last session NPS was low and we need actionable items.
Samir: I'll draft a one-slide 20-min agenda and a 3-question poll (actionable, clarity, next steps). ETA 14:00 today.
Katie Ops: Also setting the invite to include timezone hints (ET/CET/PST) and a brief run-of-show in the description.
Lee (Enablement): FYI, I added a short facilitator checklist to the runbook: 
```
- 5m intro + outcomes
- 15m migration-specific walkthrough
- 10m live Q&A
- 5m feedback + next steps
```
Emily (CS): Perfect. Once RemyBot confirms calendar, I'll DM the facilitators with the attendee priority list and escalate waitlist to NovusBio contacts. :thumbsup:
RemyBot: Waitlist bumped and priority tag added to event description.
Emily (CS): Closing this thread — thanks everyone. Postmortem notes + poll results will be posted in the #cs-workshop-feedback doc after the session.
